name: Channel 453
source:
One day, the MC  moves into a new house with old TV.  After moving out, the MC sees a flyer on TV for the newly opened 'Channel 453'...
.
.
Turn on channel 453, MC meets a guy who introduces himself as "Liotte"?

[from [url=https://bulhwa.itch.io/channel-453-shadows-of-the-game]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某天，主人公搬进一栋新房子，里面有一台旧电视。搬家后，主人公在电视上看到了新开播的“453频道”的宣传…
…
…
调到453频道后，主人公遇见了一个自称“Liotte”的家伙？
